test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
​Match the points under Column A with those under Column B

 
 

 **Column A (Subphylum)**
 **Column B (Animal)**
 
 
 
 

 i. Hexapoda
 a. Daphnia
 
 

 ii. Crustacea
 b. Mosquito
 
 

 iii. Myriapoda
 c. Limulus
 
 

 iv. Chelicerata
 d. Julus
 
 

2f
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Hexapoda** is matched with **Mosquito (i-b)**.
 
• **Crustacea** is matched with **Daphnia (ii-a)**.
 
• **Myriapoda** is matched with **Julus (iii-d)**.
 
• **Chelicerata** is matched with **Limulus (iv-c)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hexapoda**

 
 
• Hexapoda is a subphylum of arthropods that includes insects, which are characterized by having six legs.
 
• Mosquitoes are a type of insect belonging to the order Diptera within the subphylum Hexapoda.
 
 
 
• **Crustacea**
 
 
• Crustacea is a large subphylum of arthropods, including animals such as crabs, lobsters, and shrimp.
 
• Daphnia, commonly known as water fleas, belong to the subphylum Crustacea and are small planktonic crustaceans.
 
 
 
• **Myriapoda**
 
 
• Myriapoda is a subphylum of arthropods containing millipedes and centipedes.
 
• Julus is a genus of millipedes, which are characterized by having two pairs of legs per body segment.
 
 
 
• **Chelicerata**
 
 
• Chelicerata is a subphylum of arthropods that includes spiders, scorpions, and horseshoe crabs.
 
• Limulus, commonly known as the horseshoe crab, belongs to the subphylum Chelicerata and is known for its hard exoskeleton and long tail spine.
